trace.question: Is the set of cards with Adarkar Valkyrie only available outside the United States?
trace.evidence: card set Adarkar Valkyrie refers to name = 'Adarkar Valkyrie'; isForeignOnly = 1 means only available outside the United States;

attempts.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.isForeignOnly
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE c.name = 'Adarkar Valkyrie'

trace.final_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.isForeignOnly
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE c.name = 'Adarkar Valkyrie'
trace.answer: No, the Adarkar Valkyrie cards are not limited to outside the United States; the result indicates the set is not foreign-only.
